# tu 1.1.2 — quiet update check

`tu` now notices when a newer release exists and says so in one
line. Nothing blocks, nothing asks.

## What's new since `v1.1.1`

- **Once-a-day release check.** On launch, if the last check is older
  than 24 hours, a background thread asks GitHub for the newest tag
  (`curl`, two-second cap) and caches it in
  `~/.cache/tu/update-check`. The UI never waits for the answer.
- **One-line note, no modal.** When the cached tag is newer than the
  running binary, the status row shows
  `vX.Y.Z available · brew upgrade tu` (or `cargo install tmux-tu`,
  `re-run install.sh`, or the releases URL, picked from where the
  binary lives). It never covers an error or an action result.
- **Opt out.** `TU_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` disables the check and the note.

No changes to session handling, the popup, or the status-bar button.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/tu/main/install.sh | sh
```

Homebrew: `brew upgrade tu` · crates.io: `cargo install tmux-tu` ·
packages and tarballs are attached below, with `SHA256SUMS`.
